description: By Samantha J. Gross and Matt Stout. After months of preaching fiscal restraint, five of the Massachusetts House’s highest-ranking Democrats slipped at least $5 million in earmarks into the chamber’s spending plan in late April, fattening their own districts’ haul far beyond that of most others and almost entirely out of public view.
title: In closed-door budget process, Mass. House leaders scored big | Vote Russell Holmes
